mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT P.ROLE_ID, P.PERMISSION FROM T_PERMISSION P JOIN T_ROLE RO ON RO.ID = P.ROLE_ID AND RO.KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} WHERE P.ROLE_ID IN ( SELECT RR.ROLE_ID FROM T_RELATIONSHIP_ROLE RR WHERE RR.KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} AND RR.USER_ID = #{userId} UNION SELECT R.ROLE_ID FROM T_RELATIONSHIP R WHERE R.KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.ROLE_ID IS NOT NULL )
